registryBasis: Tianmen municipal government publishes local real-estate registration notices and identifies the Tianmen real-estate registration bureau as responsible for citywide registration and public record-query services. This is local custody evidence, not evidence of an open parcel geometry API.

officialSources.observation: Official Tianmen government organization page states that the Tianmen real-estate registration bureau undertakes citywide real-estate registration and related public record-query services.

Official Tianmen government registration-report index exposes public registration and integrated house-and-land registration notices; it does not expose safe parcel geometry or an anonymous parcel query.
Official Tianmen map-query page uses Baidu Maps and local page JavaScript for general institution/address map display; no cadastral parcel layer or public parcel API was identified.

requests.outcome: HTTP page fetched successfully; current HTML and inline JavaScript were inspected. The page initializes Baidu Maps for general government map points and contains no parcel feature request or parcel schema.
Official local registration-information index was available and lists registration notices. No public anonymous parcel geometry service was linked.
Official local agency page was available and described the Tianmen real-estate registration bureau's citywide remit and public-query role; no parcel endpoint or safe native ID response was exposed.
